collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A carver's apprentice produces a figure finer than anything the carver has ever made, and the village gathers to admire it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a carver's apprentice, produces a figure finer than anything the carver has ever made, and the village gathers to admire it.

choices.label: Ask the Apprentice to Teach the New Technique.
Admit the Feeling of Envy to a Friend.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The carver feels a pang of envy but still speaks warmly of the work.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The friend listens, and the carver feels lighter afterward.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friend points out that the apprentice learned from the carver, which helps a little.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The shared carving becomes a favorite in the village.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Their styles clash, and they agree to work separately but share ideas.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The apprentice glows, and the carver feels proud of their teaching.
